items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: Maybe Eddie Lang and some other people, I don't know

ctx.x: I don't know who the nominal leader was.
Yeah, that's right. I don't know either, but I know Bix and Trumbauer were on that thing. Maybe Eddie Lang and some other people, I don't know -- but ...

Well, there's another point, that a lot of -- I'll put this in a very general way -- a lot of the music that was recorded early in New York; some of the early Fletcher Henderson for example; the orchestra and not so much the accompanying groups that were accompanying the vocalists and the blues singers and so forth -- seems, some people would claim, much less 'black' whatever that might mean than, say, the music that was coming out of Chicago from people recently from New Orleans, and indeed, seems a lot less…
